Priya: Hi, first day Q: installed Homebrew on my new M2 but my dotfiles assume /usr/local. I prefer not to symlink. Thoughts?

Noah: For ARM macs just use `$(brew --prefix)` in dotfiles. If you're on fish add `set -x PATH (brew --prefix)/bin $PATH` to ~/.config/fish/config.fish.

Priya: Cool. Also asdf nodejs plugin error: `gpg: command not found` when trying to verify downloads.

Noah: `brew install gnupg` fixes it. After that run `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring` then `asdf install nodejs 16.20.0`.

Priya: Thanks. One more: our repo uses direnv but my local shell is fish and `.envrc` is bashy. Any lightweight pattern to make it cross-shell?

DevEx: Use a shim in `.envrc` to call a small POSIX script, e.g.: `source_env() { export VAR=...; } ; source <(printf '%s\n' "export VAR=...")` or keep `.envrc` minimal and let per-shell hooks load additional config from `.envrc.fish`.

Priya: Where to stash DB creds locally? 1Password or .envrc?

Noah: 1Password is preferred. Use `op` inside `.envrc` to fetch secrets so they never live in git. Example: `export DATABASE_URL=$(op item get "redwood/dev-db" --fields password)` and then `direnv allow`.
